meta_title: Fold Brain — six minutes a day
meta_description: Fold Brain, pocket brain training: six minutes a day, no subscription, with Plio. Designed for iPhone Duo, fully featured on iPhone and iPad.
og_title: Fold Brain — the brain that folds
og_description: Six minutes a day, no subscription. The game above the fold, your pencil below.
hero_title: Six minutes a day to keep your mind sharp.
hero_text: Speed Math, Stroop, Digit Memory, and Mirror. You read the prompt at the top of the screen and write your answer by hand at the bottom. Plio is with you for every exercise.
cta_note: 3 free sessions · then a one-time purchase
plio_hello: Hi, I'm Plio. Shall we train?
mock_duo_label: Math exercise on an open iPhone Duo: 37 + 48 above the fold, the answer 85 handwritten on the slate below
mock_phone_label: Math exercise on iPhone: 37 + 48 at the top, the answer 85 written on the slate at the bottom
mock_pad_label: Math exercise on iPad: 37 + 48 on the left, the answer 85 written with Apple Pencil on the slate on the right
duo_note: iPhone Duo open · one screen, folded in the middle
duo_title: The game above the fold, your pencil below.
duo_step1: The game appears on the top half, above the fold, with no gesture needed.
duo_step2: With your finger or a stylus, on the grid slate across the bottom half.
phone_note: iPhone · game on top, slate below
phone_title: The game on top, your pencil below.
phone_step1: The game appears at the top of the screen, with no gesture needed.
phone_step2: With your finger or a stylus, on the grid slate at the bottom, right under your thumb.
pad_note: iPad + Apple Pencil · game on the left, slate on the right
pad_title: The game on the left, your pencil on the right.
pad_step1: The game appears on the left side of the screen, with no gesture needed.
pad_step2: With your finger or a stylus, on the large slate on the right, with Apple Pencil.
step3_text: Right, or not quite, with the correct answer. Then on to the next exercise.
session_title: Four exercises, one session of about six minutes.
calc_text: Addition, subtraction, times tables, and division, getting trickier as you go. Answers are always whole numbers.
stroop_text: Tap the color of the ink, not the written word. Each color also has its own shape.
memory_text: Remember a sequence of 3 to 7 digits, then write it back from memory.
mirror_text: Copy the pattern as a mirror image on the other side of the fold, as if you were folding the screen over.
track_text: After each session, your brain age shows how you're doing. A stamp marks every day you play, a gold stamp every perfect session. No leaderboards.
week_label: Week: played Monday, perfect session Tuesday, played Wednesday, Thursday, and Saturday, not played Friday, Sunday still to go
devices_title: Designed for the screen that folds.
device_duo: Open: the game above the fold, the slate below. Folded to 90° and set down: the top screen becomes a blackboard and Plio sits on the edge. Closed: everything fits on the outer screen.
device_phone: The game at the top of the screen, the slate at the bottom, right under your thumb. With no fold, the screen simply splits in two.
device_pad: The game on the left, a large slate on the right for writing with a stylus.
perk_3: No account, nothing leaves your iPhone
privacy_meta_description: Fold Brain privacy policy: no data collected.
p_brief: Fold Brain collects no personal data. No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics tools. Only your purchase history goes through our payment provider, RevenueCat, under an anonymous identifier.
p_device: Your sessions, brain age, streak, stamps, and settings are stored only on this device. They are sent neither to us nor to any third party, except the scores you share with Game Center (see below). Deleting the app or using “Reset progress” erases them.
p_hand: What you write on the slate is read directly on the iPhone by Apple's text recognition. Your strokes are neither stored nor sent anywhere.
p_purchase: The “Fold Brain, Forever” purchase is paid through Apple's App Store, then verified by RevenueCat (revenuecat.com), which receives the purchase receipt and an anonymous identifier created by the app. This identifier is not linked to your name, your email, or your payment details, which we never receive. It is used only to unlock the app and restore your purchase.
p_gc: If you are signed in to Game Center, the app sends it your brain age, best streak, and achievements for the leaderboards. Game Center is an Apple service with its own privacy policy; we have no access to your account. If you are not signed in to Game Center, nothing is sent.
p_notif: The daily reminder is a local notification scheduled by your iPhone. No server is involved. You can turn it off in the app's Settings.
p_kids: Fold Brain collects no personal data from anyone, children included.
p_site: This site uses no cookies and no audience measurement tools. It is hosted by GitHub Pages and loads its fonts from Google Fonts. Your language choice is remembered in your browser and never sent anywhere.
p_changes: If this policy changes, the new version will be published in the app and on this page with its update date.
